supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: visible lateral extension beyond the outer ocular margins

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: muzzle region exhibits higher pixel intensity (lighter) relative to the darker periocular and cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: moderate 2D vertical thickness of the lower lip with perceptible slight droop

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: distinct high-contrast white focal mark visible on the lower lip region
